## 6.7 Compensated privacy relay operation

Privacy-enhancing relay operation can be a compensated contribution to shared infrastructure. Optional payments, community funding, or mixed arrangements may help sustain a routing mesh without surveillance revenue or coercive monetization.

The model’s viability must be demonstrated through costs, service quality, and resistance to operator concentration or incentive gaming. Relay participation is a possible revenue-generating role, not a guarantee that the mesh can support itself without external funding. DP6 addresses optional service pricing and DP4 evaluates the protection delivered.

##
changes.rationale: Consolidates repeated relay-revenue proposals into one financial model with explicit viability limits.
